_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 95 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use. Unlock and Requirement transcribed from the in-game challenge text (source: Battlefield 6), recorded 2026-08-01.
name: SS26

description.text: A bolt action shotgun, chambered in 12-gauge incendiary buckshot rounds. Deals reduced impact damage but sets targets on fire and burns them for a short duration. Ground shots produce an area of fire that burns enemies for a short duration if entered.

availability.label: Requirement
value: Get kills while contesting objectives as Assault (50)
